eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Kitsap; Island; Jefferson; Snohomish; Pierce; King, WA; at 4:28 PM on AUG 31, 2021 Effective until 4:58 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a test, only a test of the Emergency Alert System, from the Snohomish County Department of Emergency Management. Had this been an actual emergency, this system would bring you important information. The following tones will conclude this test. No action is needed. This is only a test.
